fact: In the reporting period 28 February 2025 to 2 April 2026, with GPE support under a grant for which UNICEF is grant agent, the Ministry of Education developed new EMIS software to digitalise its previously manual data collection and management, 47 government EMIS personnel were trained and 80 laptops and 94 desktop computers were distributed across the six zobas, with capacity-building to continue through 2026; the report names no school using the software and does not say that it holds a record per learner.
